description: This file defines the TestEvent class, which implements the Event interface. It provides functionality related to the 'test.event' event type within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, header management, and retrieving entity identifiers and metadata.

classes.name: TestEvent
classes.description: A final class representing a test event in the Ditto framework, implementing the Event interface with specific event-related methods and serialization logic.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a TestEvent instance from a JsonObject and DittoHeaders, using default entity id values.

methods.name: alternativeFromJson
methods.description: Creates a TestEvent instance from a JsonObject and DittoHeaders, using alternate entity id values.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of the event.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance of TestEvent with the specified revision.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp of the event, if available.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the metadata associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest string for the event.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JsonObject according to the specified schema version, applying the provided predicate filter.
